raw_articles.title: Beyond Embedded: How DuckDB v2.0 Shifts Architecture Toward Distributed Network Capabilities
raw_articles.summary: DuckDB Labs has previewed DuckDB v2.0, codenamed "Cyanoptera." This release includes over 10000 commits and introduces a client/server mode, enabling network connections. Improvements also encompass extension portability, advanced data types, and a new parser. Performance enhancements include asynchronous I/O and storage optimisations. General availability is expected in fall 2026. By Olimpiu Pop
